theorems.name: Submission.codim1_simons_regular_cone_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 2 ≤ m → m ≤ 6 → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → C.support ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ≠ 0 → y ∈ regularSet C ∧ HasMassDensity C y 1) → ∀ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity C 0 θ → θ ≤ 1
